All 5 acceptance criteria PASS. design_issues.screen: Partner Engineer dashboard - 'Your first 7 days' onboarding checklist
issues: Onboarding step 'Upload your first compliance doc' description is still hardcoded UK-only: 'DBS, Right-to-Work, Safeguarding or Public Liability. Any one of the four counts here.' This text does NOT switch to US doc names (Work Authorization / Background Check) when the org is US-based. The PartnerComplianceCard itself is dynamic, but the OnboardingChecklist tile is not. Non-blocking for Slice 8 but recommended follow-up for full US localisation parity.

action_items: OPTIONAL/FOLLOW-UP: Make the 'Upload your first compliance doc' onboarding-checklist tile description market-aware (use claim_doc_kinds labels) so US orgs don't see 'DBS, Right-to-Work, Safeguarding or Public Liability'.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerComplianceCard.js correctly uses (data.required_kinds || fallback).map() at line 292 — fallback list ['dbs','rtw','safeguarding','public_liability'] is sensible. claimKinds at line 244 also reads from data.claim_doc_kinds with the UK fallback. Defensive and backward-compatible.
Header comment block at top of file (lines 5-6) still names UK docs only ('DBS, Right to Work, Safeguarding, Public Liability'). Cosmetic: update the docstring to mention US docs too.
Inline banner copy at lines 263 ('the deadline nudges them to upload DBS / RTW before grace lapses') is now a stale comment — the banner actually pulls claimLabels dynamically. Cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing engineer.smoke user with org country_code temporarily set to US by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slice 8 (US Engineer Compliance) verified end-to-end on /partner-engineer. API GET /api/partners/me/compliance-docs returned required_kinds=['work_authorization','background_check','public_liability'], claim_doc_kinds=['work_authorization','background_check'], country_code='US'. UI rendered exactly those 3 rows and hid DBS/RTW/Safeguarding. wa-doc-type dropdown contains: Form I-9, US Passport, Green Card (Permanent Resident), Employment Authorization (EAD), Social Security Card, Driver's License (+ SSN), Work Visa (plus the empty placeholder). bg-provider placeholder = 'Provider (e.g. Checkr)'. Grace banner text: 'Upload your Work Authorization or Background Check within 4 days...'. compliance-summary text: '0/3 verified · 4d left to upload'. Main agent can self-verify by reverting org country_code and confirming UK rows return. Note follow-up: OnboardingChecklist 'Upload your first compliance doc' tile still has UK-only hardcoded description.
